summary: Ichor Holdings, Ltd. filed an 8-K regarding entry into a sales agreement for an at-the-market (ATM) offering of up to $200 million of its ordinary shares. The company will sell shares through agents TD Securities, Stifel, Needham, and Craig-Hallum on a commercially reasonable efforts basis, with a 3% commission. Net proceeds will repay term loan debt and for general corporate purposes. This is an ordinary shelf takedown/ATM facility, not a special situation. No terms like price per share or premium are stated, and no board recommendation or advisors are named. The filing is a routine capital markets activity with no structural complexity or regulatory clock; nothing to watch from a special-situations perspective.
